correctness.rationale: For every integer N>=2 and 1<=k<N under δ>max{a(N−1),b(N−1)}, the positive Perron eigenvalue belongs to the symmetric 2×2 quotient T_k, and δ above both diagonals makes det(δI−T_k)<0 equivalent to c²>R(k). The ratio s=k/(N−k) yields R=(UC/s+BVs+UV+BC)/N², unique s0=sqrt(UC/BV), R0=(sqrt(UV)+sqrt(BC))²/N²; square completion gives exact penalty sqrt(UBVC)*(k−k0)²/[k k0 (N−k)(N−k0)]. Floor/ceiling restrict all integer minimizers, including N=2 boundary; equality c=c_crit is not strictly supercritical. Independent 1,595 rational-parameter checks plus N=5 exact fractions confirm, not replace, the proof.

originality.rationale: Classical metapopulation-capacity thresholds and equitable partitions determine fixed-composition spectra but do not, in the inspected literature, give the all-integer optimum and exact positive rounding penalty. The algebra is elementary once the block model is chosen, so historical implicit-derivation overlap is a genuine risk; best-of-knowledge not absolute priority.
residual_risks: General matrix theory makes the claim short once the right quotient and AM–GM substitution are chosen; older ecological/spectral literature might implicitly contain the same optimized threshold.
No finite stochastic process nonextinction conclusion; the linear deterministic capacity criterion is the only survival interpretation.
Not all older primary full texts were accessible.
